description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kimbulapitiya, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511211
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Nos. 141 and 143) in Kimbulapitiya, including detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and cadastral references. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, property ownership determination, and title settlement processes.
